name: Weber County, UT
findings: Weber County has 530 nonprofit organizations. 237 of them (45%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 189 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (20% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, Weber County has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list civic or political action
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in Weber County list civic or political action in their tax returns or on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.4 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 13 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: Why are ways to take civic or political action so common here? Who takes part, and who might not be reached?

observations.title: Foundation organizations that list no opportunities
observations.text: 44 foundation organizations here list none of the four kinds of opportunity in their tax returns or on their websites. Many may still offer them without describing them there.

confidence.text: Based on 44 organizations here; 35% of all organizations here have no identified type.

observations.question: What do foundation organizations here do in the community? How do people find out about them?
